questions.question: A bike can finish a certain journey in 6 hours at the speed of 92 km/hr. In order to cover the same distance in 3 hours, the speed of the bike (in km/hr) must be increased by ____.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Time ratio** (Initial : New) = 6 : 3 = 2 : 1

Since **Distance** is constant, **Speed ratio** is inverse of **Time ratio** = 1 : 2

1 unit (Initial Speed) = 92 km/hr

**Increase in speed** required = 2 − 1 = 1 unit = 92 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 92 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial Speed = 92 km/hr, Initial Time = 6 hours, New Time = 3 hours

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe21668f6e9dc701a4940f53846a01fb4b7e8ee437ea7166fb5704d17423f084.png] 

⇒ **Total Distance** = 92 km/hr × 6 hours

⇒ **Total Distance** = 552 km

⇒ **Required New Speed** = Total Distance ÷ New Time

⇒ **New Speed** = 552 ÷ 3 = 184 km/hr

⇒ **Increase in Speed** = New Speed − Initial Speed

⇒ **Increase in Speed** = 184 − 92 = 92 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 92 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Variation Rule

When distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional (S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂).

Average Speed

If a journey is covered in two equal distances at speeds x and y, average speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

Speed of two objects moving in the same direction is (S₁ − S₂) and in opposite directions is (S₁ + S₂).</p

questions.question: The average of 6 numbers is 18. If each number is increased by 5, what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Property: If each **observation** in a data set is increased by a constant **k**, the **mean average** of the set also increases by exactly **k**.

New Average = **Old Average** + **Increase Value**

⇒ New Average = 18 + 5 = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number of observations = 6 | Original average = 18 | Increase per number = 5

**Formula Used:** Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80482217760a766a1d94117cb53ef690171336fa0605a1cdea46918a4716e121.png] 

⇒ Sum of original 6 numbers = 18 × 6 = 108

⇒ Total increase after adding 5 to each number = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ New Total Sum = 108 + 30 = 138

⇒ New Average = 138 ÷ 6 = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Operations on Average

If every term is multiplied by **k**, the average is multiplied by **k**. If every term is divided by **k**, the average is divided by **k**.

Average of Consecutive Numbers

The average of **n** consecutive numbers is the middle term if **n** is odd, or the mean of the two middle terms if **n** is even.

Weighted Average Formula

Weighted Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), used when combining two groups with different averages.</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper fixes the marked price of an item 52% above its cost price. What percentage of discount on the marked price should be allowed to gain 14%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the relationship: **MP ÷ CP = (100 + P%) ÷ (100 − D%)**.

Given: **MP = 152** (if CP = 100) and **Profit = 14%**.

152 ÷ 100 = (100 + 14) ÷ (100 − D).

152 ÷ 100 = 114 ÷ (100 − D) ⇒ 100 − D = (114 × 100) ÷ 152.

100 − D = 75 ⇒ **D = 25%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marked Price (MP) is 52% above Cost Price (CP), Profit = 14%.

**Formulas:** SP = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 | Discount% = (MP − SP) ÷ MP × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df22b5d8dc73c196aca7beabf468c4c750c18e47492fb0140387443eb308e390.png] 

⇒ Let **Cost Price (CP)** = 100.

⇒ **Marked Price (MP)** = 100 + 52% of 100 = 152.

⇒ Desired **Profit** = 14%, so **Selling Price (SP)** = 100 + 14 = 114.

⇒ **Discount Amount** = MP − SP = 152 − 114 = 38.

⇒ **Discount%** = (38 ÷ 152) × 100 = 1/4 × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP, MP, Profit and Discount

The ratio of MP to CP is always constant for a given profit and discount: **MP/CP = (100 + Gain%) / (100 − Discount%)**.

Marked Price

It is the price displayed on the label of an item, also known as the **List Price**.</p

questions.question: Find the smallest number by which 6627 must be multiplied to make it a perfect square.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Perform **Prime Factorisation** of 6627.

6627 = 3 × 13 × 13 × 13 = 3¹ × 13³.

To make it a **perfect square**, all prime factors must have **even powers**.

Required multipliers = 3¹ × 13¹ = 39. (Wait, let us re-check the division).

6627 ÷ 3 = 2209. We know 2209 = 47².

∴ 6627 = 3 × 47². The **unpaired factor** is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = 6627.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52fd5e8c93a15052c0517a422078d60b3cf4199b431d1585ddc0cd30ee2105ab.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits of 6627 = 6 + 6 + 2 + 7 = 21 (Divisible by 3).

⇒ 6627 ÷ 3 = 2209.

⇒ 2209 is a **perfect square** since √2209 = 47.

⇒ Prime factorisation of 6627 = 3¹ × 47².

⇒ For a number to be a **perfect square**, the power of every prime factor must be **even**.

⇒ Here, 3 has a power of 1. To make it even, we must multiply by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Square Condition

A number is a perfect square if all its prime factors appear in **pairs** (even exponents).

Smallest Multiplier/Divisor

To find the smallest number to multiply/divide to make a perfect square, identify the **unpaired factors** in the prime factorisation.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 3.</p

questions.question: The enactment of the first Cooperative Credit Societies Act in 1904 was influenced by which of the following?

• The act was a landmark step in the development of **cooperative movements in India**, especially in rural areas.
 
• It laid the foundation for the establishment of **cooperative societies**, which were designed to provide credit at reasonable rates and improve the financial stability of farmers.
 
• The initiative was crucial for addressing the agricultural distress caused by recurring famines and boosting rural development.

• Its recommendations were more focused on **land tenure systems, irrigation, marketing, and agricultural practices**, rather than rural credit.
 
 
 
• **Hunter Commission**__
 __
 
• The **Hunter Commission**, established in **1882**, dealt with **education reforms** in India and had no direct connection to agricultural credit or the Cooperative Credit Societies Act.
 
• It primarily focused on expanding and improving **primary and secondary education** in India.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office and secrecy to the Union Ministers under Article 75(4) of the Constitution of India?

__
 
• Under **Article 75(4) of the Constitution of India**, the oath of office and secrecy is administered to the Union Ministers by the **President of India.**
 
• The oath is taken in accordance with the provisions of the **Third Schedule** of the Constitution.
 
• The President ensures that the Union Ministers pledge to uphold the **Constitution of India**, maintain secrecy, and perform their duties faithfully.
 
• The President is the head of the state and serves as the **constitutional authority** responsible for appointing Union Ministers as per the advice of the **Prime Minister.**
 
• This process reflects the principle of maintaining the integrity and solemnity of the **parliamentary democracy** in India.

__

 __
 
• The **Chief Justice of India (CJI)** primarily heads the judiciary and does not administer the oath of office and secrecy to Union Ministers.
 
• The Chief Justice is responsible for interpreting the Constitution and overseeing the functioning of the **Supreme Court of India.**
 
• However, the CJI administers the oath to the **President of India and Governors** in specific circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister**__
 __
 
• The **Prime Minister** acts as the head of the government and advises the President on the appointment of Union Ministers.
 
• While the Prime Minister plays a significant role in governance, he/she does not administer the oath to Union Ministers.
 
 
 
• **Vice President**__
 
 
• The **Vice President of India** is primarily responsible for officiating in the absence of the President and serves as the Chairman of the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• The Vice President does not have the constitutional authority to administer the oath to Union Ministers.

questions.question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 8%, 16% and 3%. (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective price percentage = (100 − d₁)% × (100 − d₂)% × (100 − d₃)%

Effective price = 100 × (92/100) × (84/100) × (97/100)

Effective price = 0.92 × 0.84 × 97% = 0.7728 × 97%

Effective price = 74.9616% ≈ 74.96%

**∴ The correct answer is 74.96%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Three consecutive discounts of **8%**, **16%**, and **3%**.

**Formulas:** Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100 × (100 − d₃)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cb129b2f8b43086d25c305a0159454795c5f017ea3c6d25c44a6be947a91084.png] 

⇒ Let the **Marked Price** be 100 units.

⇒ Price after 8% discount = 100 − 8 = 92 units.

⇒ Price after 16% discount = 92 − (16% of 92) = 92 − 14.72 = 77.28 units.

⇒ Price after 3% discount = 77.28 − (3% of 77.28) = 77.28 − 2.3184 = 74.9616 units.

⇒ **Effective Price Percentage** = (74.9616/100) × 100 ≈ 74.96%.

**∴ The correct answer is 74.96%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Discount Rate

To find the total discount, use the formula for successive discounts: a + b − (ab/100). Subtracting this from 100 gives the final price.

Relationship between MP and SP

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (1 − Discount%/100). The effective price percentage is essentially the ratio of SP to MP expressed as a percentage.</p

questions.question: If sectheta+tantheta = 2, then what is the value of 3sectheta+4?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **secθ + tanθ = 2**. Then **secθ − tanθ = 1/2**.

Adding both: 2secθ = 2 + 1/2 = 5/2 ⇒ **secθ = 5/4**.

Find: 3secθ + 4 = 3(5/4) + 4 = 15/4 + 16/4 = **31/4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 31/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d3d746821a2281e66725973e65712cddbcd03f35ee24b8372404cf9704fb16.png] 

**Given:** secθ + tanθ = 2

**Formula Used:** sec²θ − tan²θ = 1 ⇒ (secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ 2 × (secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ secθ − tanθ = 1/2

⇒ (secθ + tanθ) + (secθ − tanθ) = 2 + 1/2

⇒ 2secθ = 5/2

⇒ secθ = 5/4

⇒ 3secθ + 4 = 3 × (5/4) + 4

⇒ 15/4 + 4 = (15 + 16)/4 = 31/4

**∴ The correct answer is 31/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identity

The identity **1 + tan²θ = sec²θ** leads to the reciprocal relationship **(secθ + tanθ) = 1 / (secθ − tanθ)**.

Cosecant Identity

Similarly, **1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ**, meaning **(cosecθ + cotθ) = 1 / (cosecθ − cotθ)**.

Pythagorean Triplets

Since secθ = 5/4 (Hypotenuse/Base), the **Perpendicular** is √(5² − 4²) = 3, forming a 3-4-5 triplet.</p

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 25pi{cm²}. The volume of the sphere is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Surface Area** = 4πr² = 25π ⇒ r² = 25/4 ⇒ **r = 5/2 cm**.

**Volume** = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(5/2)³ = (4/3)π(125/8).

On simplifying, **Volume** = (125π)/6 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface Area of **Sphere** = 25π cm²

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Surface Area (S) = 4πr²

⇒ Volume (V) = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1faeab838b88972428655b41bdbca7d05ffad777668fec42feb3b183f15d98.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4πr² = 25π

⇒ r² = 25/4

⇒ r = √(25/4) = 5/2 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (5/2)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (125/8)

⇒ Volume = (1 × π × 125) / (3 × 2)

⇒ Volume = 125π/6 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

A sphere is a perfectly round geometrical object in three-dimensional space. Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Hemisphere Formulas

For a solid hemisphere, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², Total Surface Area = 3πr², and Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio relations

If the ratio of radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³:b³.</p

questions.question: With whose assistance did Chandragupta Maurya overthrow the Nanda dynasty?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chanakya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chanakya**, also known as **Kautilya** or **Vishnugupta**, was a renowned ancient Indian philosopher, economist, and statesman.
 
• He played a pivotal role in assisting **Chandragupta Maurya** in overthrowing the **Nanda dynasty** and establishing the **Maurya Empire**.
 
• Chanakya is credited with authoring the **Arthashastra**, an ancient Indian treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.
 
• He was a master strategist who used his knowledge and wit to mentor Chandragupta Maurya and unite the fragmented regions of India under a single empire.

Filling time (A) = 6 hours

Net filling time (A − Leak) = 7(1/5) = 36/5 hours

Leak empty time = (Product of times) ÷ (Difference of times)

Leak empty time = (6 × 36/5) ÷ (36/5 − 6) = (216/5) ÷ (6/5) = 36 hours

 Pump (A) 6 36 units 6

questions.question: A boat takes 18 minutes to go 59.4 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 3 : 2. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 29.3 km upstream and 51.5 km downstream?

1 unit = 198 kmph ⇒ u = 3 × 198 = 594 kmph, v = 2 × 198 = 396 kmph.

Downstream Speed (D) = u + v = 5 unit = 5 × 198 = 990 kmph.

Total Time = (29.3 ÷ 198) + (51.5 ÷ 990) ≈ 0.148 + 0.052 = 0.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.2 hours.**

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = 59.4 ÷ 0.3 = 198 kmph.

⇒ Let u = 3x and v = 2x. Then U = 3x − 2x = x.

⇒ x = 198 kmph.

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 3x + 2x = 5x = 5 × 198 = 990 kmph.

⇒ Time for 29.3 km Upstream = 29.3 ÷ 198 ≈ 0.14798 hours.

⇒ Time for 51.5 km Downstream = 51.5 ÷ 990 ≈ 0.05202 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.14798 + 0.05202 = 0.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.2 hours.**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream Speed = Speed of boat (u) − Speed of stream (v). Downstream Speed = Speed of boat (u) + Speed of stream (v).

Still Water and Stream Speed Formulas

Speed of boat in still water (u) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2. Speed of stream (v) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.

questions.question: In industrial settings, Freon-12 is most commonly manufactured by which chemical reaction?

__
 
• **Swarts reaction** is a method for the preparation of haloalkanes, particularly fluorinated compounds.
 
• In this reaction, **metal fluorides** like AgF, SbF3, or Hg2F2 are used to replace halogens (chlorine or bromine) in alkyl halides.
 
• Freon-12 (**Dichlorodifluoromethane**) is commonly prepared using the Swarts reaction as it involves the replacement of chlorine atoms in chlorinated hydrocarbons with fluorine atoms.
 
• The reaction is widely applied in the **industrial production of Freon compounds**, which are used as refrigerants.
 
• Freon-12 has been extensively utilized in **air conditioning and refrigeration systems** due to its physical properties, such as low boiling point and non-flammability.
 
• However, its use has been phased out in many countries due to its **ozone-depleting potential** under the Montreal Protocol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Substitution reaction**__

 __
 
• In a substitution reaction, one atom or group in a molecule is replaced by another atom or group.
 
• It is a common reaction in organic chemistry and involves mechanisms like **SN1 and SN2 reactions**.
 
• While substitution reactions are used for synthesizing various compounds, they are not the primary method for producing fluorinated hydrocarbons like Freon-12.
 
 
 
• **Wurtz reaction**__
 __
 
• The Wurtz reaction is a method used to prepare higher alkanes by reacting alkyl halides with sodium in dry ether.
 
• This reaction is not suitable for the production of fluorinated hydrocarbons like Freon-12.
 
 
 
• **Elimination reaction**__
 
 
• Elimination reactions involve the removal of atoms or groups from a molecule, resulting in the formation of double or triple bonds.
 
• These reactions do not involve the direct substitution of halogens with fluorine and are unrelated to the synthesis of Freon compounds.

questions.question: The sum of the ages of Ramesh and Mahesh is (2x² - 3x²y + y² + 3x y ^ 2) years. Age of Ramesh is (x ^ 2 + 3x ^ 2 y + y ^ 2 + 3x y ^ 2) years. Find the age of Mahesh.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Mahesh** age = (Sum of ages) − (**Ramesh** age)

Mahesh age = (2x² − 3x²y + y² + 3xy²) − (x² + 3x²y + y² + 3xy²)

Canceling common terms (y² and 3xy²): (2x² − 3x²y) − (x² + 3x²y)

Subtracting like terms: x² − 6x²y

**∴ The correct answer is (x² − 6x²y) years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of ages of **Ramesh** and **Mahesh** = 2x² − 3x²y + y² + 3xy²

Age of **Ramesh** = x² + 3x²y + y² + 3xy²

**Formula Used:**

Age of **Mahesh** = **Total Sum** − Age of **Ramesh**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Age of **Mahesh** = (2x² − 3x²y + y² + 3xy²) − (x² + 3x²y + y² + 3xy²)

⇒ Age of **Mahesh** = 2x² − 3x²y + y² + 3xy² − x² − 3x²y − y² − 3xy²

⇒ Grouping like terms: (2x² − x²) + (−3x²y − 3x²y) + (y² − y²) + (3xy² − 3xy²)

⇒ Age of **Mahesh** = x² − 6x²y + 0 + 0

⇒ Age of **Mahesh** = x² − 6x²y

**∴ The correct answer is (x² − 6x²y) years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Subtraction

When subtracting algebraic expressions, change the sign of every term in the expression being subtracted and then combine like terms.

Like Terms

Like terms are terms that have the same variables raised to the same powers. Only like terms can be added or subtracted (e.g., x²y and x²y).</p

questions.question:
If the mode of the following data is 125, then what is the value of x?

 
 

 Class
 110-115
 115-120
 120-125
 125-130
 130-135
 
 

 Frequency
 13
 31
 39

 15
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Since the given **Mode** is exactly 125, which lies on the boundary of the classes 120−125 and 125−130, the frequencies of these two adjacent classes must be equal to maintain symmetry.

⇒ Frequency of class (120−125) = Frequency of class (125−130)

⇒ 39 = x

⇒ x = 39

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mode of the data = 125

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/018b816eff008f92a86c7f6c648ab99ece7dbfea21ed0ae740e4a04324062b99.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Mode = L + [ (f₁ − f₀) ÷ (2f₁ − f₀ − f₂) ] × h

Where:

L = Lower limit of the modal class

f₁ = Frequency of the modal class

f₀ = Frequency of the class preceding the modal class

f₂ = Frequency of the class succeeding the modal class

h = Class width (size of class interval)

**Calculations:**

Since the mode is 125, it lies on the boundary of the classes 120−125 and 125−130. We can analyze both cases:

**Case 1: Assuming 120−125 is the modal class**

⇒ L = 120, f₁ = 39, f₀ = 31, f₂ = x, h = 5

⇒ 125 = 120 + [ (39 − 31) ÷ (2 × 39 − 31 − x) ] × 5

⇒ 5 = [ 8 ÷ (78 − 31 − x) ] × 5

⇒ 1 = 8 ÷ (47 − x)

⇒ 47 − x = 8

⇒ x = 39

**Case 2: Assuming 125−130 is the modal class**

⇒ L = 125, f₁ = x, f₀ = 39, f₂ = 15, h = 5

⇒ 125 = 125 + [ (x − 39) ÷ (2x − 39 − 15) ] × 5

⇒ 0 = [ (x − 39) ÷ (2x − 54) ] × 5

⇒ x − 39 = 0

⇒ x = 39

Both cases consistently yield **x = 39**.

**Why other options are incorrect:**

**Option (1) 48:** If x = 48, the modal class is 125−130. Mode = 125 + [ (48 − 39) ÷ (2 × 48 − 39 − 15) ] × 5 = 125 + [ 9 ÷ 42 ] × 5 ≈ 126.07 ≠ 125.

**Option (2) 40:** If x = 40, the modal class is 125−130. Mode = 125 + [ (40 − 39) ÷ (2 × 40 − 39 − 15) ] × 5 = 125 + [ 1 ÷ 26 ] × 5 ≈ 125.19 ≠ 125.

**Option (3) 31:** If x = 31, the modal class is 120−125. Mode = 120 + [ (39 − 31) ÷ (2 × 39 − 31 − 31) ] × 5 = 120 + [ 8 ÷ 16 ] × 5 = 122.5 ≠ 125.

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

**__Additional Information__**

Modal Class

The class interval in a grouped frequency distribution that has the highest frequency.

Empirical Relationship

The relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

Symmetric Distribution

In a perfectly symmetric distribution, Mean = Median = Mode.</p

questions.question: The doctrine of judicial review originated in which country?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The doctrine of **judicial review** originated in the **United States of America**.
 
• The concept was established through the landmark case of **Marbury v. Madison (1803)**, which was presided over by Chief Justice **John Marshall**.
 
• This case established the principle that the **Supreme Court of the United States** has the authority to review and invalidate laws and actions of the executive and legislative branches if they conflict with the **U.S. Constitution**.
 
• Judicial review is considered a fundamental aspect of the **separation of powers** and ensures that no branch of government exceeds its constitutional limits.
 
• The doctrine serves as a mechanism to protect the rights of individuals and maintain the supremacy of the **Constitution** in the governance of the country.
 
• In the United States, judicial review plays a critical role in maintaining the principle of **checks and balances** among the three branches of government: the legislative, executive, and judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The United Kingdom follows the principle of **parliamentary sovereignty**, meaning Parliament is the supreme legal authority.
 
• Unlike the United States, the concept of judicial review is limited in the UK. Courts cannot overrule legislation passed by Parliament but can review whether public authorities act within their legal powers.
 
 
 
• **India**__
 __
 
• India adopted the concept of **judicial review** from the United States, and it is enshrined in the Indian Constitution.
 
• Articles **13, 32, and 136** of the Indian Constitution empower courts to review the constitutionality of laws and executive actions.
 
 
 
• **France**__
 
 
• France follows the **civil law system**, and judicial review as in the U.S. does not exist.
 
• The **Constitutional Council** of France examines the constitutionality of laws but only before they are enacted, not after.

questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 18 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 6 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be **L** and **shorter side** be **(L − 18)**.

Given: **Area** = 6 × **Perimeter**

L(L − 18) = 6 × 2(L + L − 18) ⇒ L(L − 18) = 12(2L − 18)

Test options: If **L = 36**, then 36(18) = 648 and 12(72 − 18) = 12(54) = 648. Both match.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let **Longer side (Length)** = **x** cm

**Shorter side (Breadth)** = **(x − 18)** cm

**Formula Used:**

**Area of Rectangle** = Length × Breadth

**Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2(Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ff71b51a9c9df408f0fb213b8b198a63e74696a3ca603ece8cbd53b976d982.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 6 × Perimeter

⇒ x(x − 18) = 6 × [2(x + x − 18)]

⇒ x² − 18x = 12(2x − 18)

⇒ x² − 18x = 24x − 216

⇒ x² − 42x + 216 = 0

⇒ x² − 36x − 6x + 216 = 0

⇒ x(x − 36) − 6(x − 36) = 0

⇒ (x − 36)(x − 6) = 0

⇒ x = 36 or x = 6

⇒ Since breadth = x − 18, x cannot be 6 (as side cannot be negative).

⇒ **Length** = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles are 90°. Diagonal d = √(L² + B²).

Quadratic Roots Shortcut

For ax² + bx + c = 0, if the sum of roots is −b/a and product is c/a, the factors of 216 that sum to 42 are 36 and 6.</p

questions.question: What defines a conjoint vascular bundle?

options.text: Xylem and phloem alternate along the radii
Xylem only on the outer side
Xylem and phloem present on the same radius

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Xylem and phloem present on the same radius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **conjoint vascular bundle** is a type of vascular bundle where both **xylem** and **phloem** are present together on the same radius of the stem or root.
 
• It is a characteristic feature of most **angiosperms** and is commonly found in **dicot stems** and **monocot stems**.
 
• In this type of arrangement, the **xylem** is typically located towards the inner side (adaxial side), while the **phloem** is positioned towards the outer side (abaxial side).
 
• Conjoint vascular bundles are further classified into two types:
 
 
• **Collateral**: Xylem and phloem are present side by side in the same bundle (e.g., sunflower stem).
 
• **Bicollateral**: Xylem is sandwiched between two layers of phloem (e.g., Cucurbita stem).
 
 
 
• In most cases, conjoint vascular bundles are surrounded by a layer of **parenchyma cells**, which form the vascular cambium in dicots.
 
• This arrangement is efficient for the transport of **water**, **minerals**, and **organic nutrients** throughout the plant body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Xylem and phloem alternate along the radii**__

 __
 
• This arrangement describes a **radial vascular bundle**, where xylem and phloem are located on alternate radii.
 
• Radial vascular bundles are found in **roots** of both monocots and dicots.
 
 
 
• **Xylem only on the outer side**__
 __
 
• This statement is incorrect because xylem is usually located on the inner side in a conjoint vascular bundle.
 
• However, in **open vascular bundles**, the cambium allows for secondary growth, leading to the formation of additional xylem on the inside.
 
 
 
• **Cambium is absent**__
 
 
• This condition is seen in **closed vascular bundles**, which are common in **monocots**.
 
• In such bundles, there is no cambium, so secondary growth does not occur.

questions.question: 6 times the present age of Sujatha is 6 years more than 3 times the present age of Vanita. After 7 years, 4 times the age of Vanita will be 6 years less than 6 times the age of Sujatha. The age of Vanita is k years more than that of Sujatha. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the present age of **Sujatha** be S and **Vanita** be V.

From the first condition: 6S = 3V + 6 → 2S − V = 2 → V = 2S − 2.

From the second condition, after 7 years: 4(V + 7) = 6(S + 7) − 6 → 4V + 28 = 6S + 36 → 4V − 6S = 8.

Substitute V = 2S − 2 into the second equation: 4(2S − 2) − 6S = 8 → 2S = 16 → S = 8 years, and V = 14 years.

The difference k = V − S = 14 − 8 = 6 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/182cb408a21fc5a74d0dabb2c4800e7391b51a5f7ce584f8512b38e4cba71a5d.png] 

Let **Sujatha's present age** be S and **Vanita's present age** be V.

According to the first statement:

⇒ 6S = 3V + 6

⇒ 2S = V + 2

⇒ V = 2S − 2 —— (Equation 1)

According to the second statement, after 7 years:

⇒ Age of Sujatha after 7 years = S + 7

⇒ Age of Vanita after 7 years = V + 7

⇒ 4(V + 7) = 6(S + 7) − 6

⇒ 4V + 28 = 6S + 42 − 6

⇒ 4V + 28 = 6S + 36

⇒ 4V − 6S = 8

⇒ 2V − 3S = 4 —— (Equation 2)

Substitute Equation 1 into Equation 2:

⇒ 2(2S − 2) − 3S = 4

⇒ 4S − 4 − 3S = 4

⇒ S = 8

Substitute S = 8 into Equation 1:

⇒ V = 2(8) − 2 = 14

We are given that Vanita is k years older than Sujatha:

⇒ V = S + k

⇒ 14 = 8 + k

⇒ k = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations in Two Variables

Problems on ages are solved by formulating algebraic equations based on present conditions and past/future shifts, then using substitution or elimination methods.

Age Difference Invariance

The difference in age between two people remains constant throughout their lives. Thus, the value of k will always be the same regardless of the number of years passed.</p

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 64?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by **64** if its last **6 digits** are divisible by 64, or if it is a multiple of 8 and 16.

Check **5760**: It ends in 0 and is an even number. 5760 ÷ 64 = 90.

Odd numbers like **5327**, **5129**, and **4797** can never be divisible by an even number like 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 5327, 5129, 5760, 4797.

**Property:** For a number to be divisible by **64** (which is 2⁶), the number must be **even**.

⇒ 5327 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ 5129 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ 4797 is **Odd** → Not divisible.

⇒ Checking 5760: 5760 ÷ 64

⇒ 5760 ÷ 8 = 720

⇒ 720 ÷ 8 = 90

⇒ Since 5760 is divisible by 8 × 8 (which is 64), it is the correct number.

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by powers of 2

A number is divisible by 2ⁿ if the last **n digits** of the number are divisible by 2ⁿ. For 64 (2⁶), the last 6 digits must be divisible by 64.

Even and Odd Rule

An **even divisor** can only divide **even numbers**. If the divisor is 64, any number ending in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9 is automatically excluded.

Divisibility by 8

A number is divisible by 8 if its last **three digits** are divisible by 8. This is a prerequisite for divisibility by 64.</p

questions.question: The mean proportional between (9 + 4sqrt{5}) { and } (18 - 8sqrt{5})

Mean proportional between **a** and **b** is √(a × b).

Product = 2 × (9² − (4√5)²) = 2 × (81 − 80) = 2 × 1 = 2.

Mean Proportional = √2.

**∴ The correct answer is √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

First number (a) = 9 + 4√5

Second number (b) = 18 − 8√5 = 2(9 − 4√5)

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional **x** between **a** and **b** is given by x = √(a × b)

Algebraic Identity: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ x = √[(9 + 4√5) × (18 − 8√5)]

⇒ x = √[(9 + 4√5) × 2 × (9 − 4√5)]

⇒ x = √[2 × (9 + 4√5)(9 − 4√5)]

⇒ x = √[2 × (9² − (4√5)²)]

⇒ x = √[2 × (81 − 16 × 5)]

⇒ x = √[2 × (81 − 80)]

⇒ x = √[2 × 1]

⇒ x = √2

**∴ The correct answer is √2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

If three quantities a, b, c are in continued proportion such that a:b = b:c, then b is the mean proportional and b² = ac.

Third Proportional

In the continued proportion a:b = b:c, the value c is called the third proportional, calculated as c = b²/a.

Fourth Proportional

If a:b = c:d, then d is the fourth proportional to a, b, c, calculated as d = (b × c)/a.</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys 20 pens at ₹15 each and another 30 pens at ₹10 each. He mixes all the pens and sells them at ₹14 each. What is the profit or loss per pen he makes on an average?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total pens = 20 + 30 = 50 pens.

Weighted Average CP = (20 × 15 + 30 × 10) ÷ 50.

Average CP = (300 + 300) ÷ 50 = 600 ÷ 50 = ₹12 per pen.

Selling Price (SP) = ₹14 per pen.

Profit per pen = SP − CP = 14 − 12 = ₹2.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2 profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Formulas: Total CP = (Q₁ × C₁) + (Q₂ × C₂) | Average CP = Total CP ÷ Total Quantity | Profit = SP − CP
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d50df1d70232f0949aaa3dd56b031829802b7cc31427045888b5930033b7ffb.png] 
⇒ Total CP = (20 × 15) + (30 × 10) = 300 + 300 = ₹600.
⇒ Total Quantity = 20 + 30 = 50 pens.
⇒ Average CP per pen = 600 ÷ 50 = ₹12.
⇒ Selling Price per pen = ₹14.
⇒ Profit per pen = 14 − 12 = ₹2.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2 profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Cost

When items of different prices are mixed, the average cost price is calculated by dividing the total cost of all items by the total quantity.

Profit and Loss

If Selling Price (SP) > Cost Price (CP), it is a Profit. Profit Percentage = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

questions.question: A and B complete a work in 6 days. If A alone can do it in 7 days, then B alone can do it in ______________ days.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Time taken by **B** = (**Product** of days) ÷ (**Difference** of days)

⇒ Time = (7 × 6) ÷ (7 − 6)

⇒ Time = 42 ÷ 1 = 42 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (**A + B**) = 6 days

Time taken by **A** alone = 7 days

**Method:** LCM Method (Total Work ÷ Efficiency)
 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 **A + B** 6 42 7 
 **A** 7 6 
⇒ **Efficiency** of (A + B) = 7 units/day

⇒ **Efficiency** of A = 6 units/day

⇒ **Efficiency** of B = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ **Efficiency** of B = 7 − 6 = 1 unit/day

⇒ **Time taken by B** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ **Time** = 42 ÷ 1 = 42 days

**∴ The correct answer is 42 days.**
